subject.title: fix(qqbot): add exponential backoff, jitter, and circuit breaker to token refresh retry

question: Should QQBot background token refresh pause for five minutes after six consecutive token-refresh failures by default?
rationale: That default reduces pressure on Tencent during outages, but it can also delay channel recovery after the token endpoint returns; automation cannot choose the product availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept The Cooldown After Fixes
options.body: Keep the five-minute cooldown if the final delay cap, lint failure, and real loop proof are fixed before merge.

options.title: Use A Shorter Recovery Default
options.body: Keep exponential backoff and jitter but choose a shorter cooldown or threshold so outage recovery is less delayed.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want circuit-breaker retry behavior in the bundled QQBot token manager.

recommendation.title: Accept The Cooldown After Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the five-minute cooldown if the final delay cap, lint failure, and real loop proof are fixed before merge.
